subject: Kickoff: SkyBridge production cutover & evaluation plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@skybridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: SkyBridge production cutover & evaluation plan

Jordan — great to be moving forward, and congrats on the closed contract. Per our conversation, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation plan: canary rollout, data migration windows, training cadence, and the evaluation plan you'll run during the canary.

High-level proposed timeline (first draft):
- Week 0 (Jun 21–25): Contract finalization + change order (DocuSign) and security handoff
- Week 1 (Jun 28–Jul 2): Pre-cutover smoke tests + infra provisioning (staging)
- Week 2 (Jul 5–9): Canary (10% traffic, 48–72h per cohort) + quality evals
- Week 3 (Jul 12–16): Progressive migration (50% -> 100%) with rollback windows
- Week 4 (Jul 19–23): Full cutover verification + team training sessions

Immediate asks for you:
1) Confirm preferred canary start date (we tentatively set Jul 5)
2) Who will be our on-call for data migration (name + phone)
3) Any constraints on maintenance windows (night vs weekend)

Attachments included: MAP_SkyBridge_v1.pdf (draft MAP), Cutover_Playbook_SkyBridge.docx (ops playbook).

I'll book a 30-min kickoff once you confirm the canary date. Marissa and Steph are looped for migration and enablement planning.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_SkyBridge_v1.pdf (PDF, 450KB)]
[Attachment: Cutover_Playbook_SkyBridge.docx (DOCX, 1.2MB)]

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@skybridge.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@skybridge.io>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: SkyBridge production cutover & evaluation plan

Karthik — thanks, appreciate the clear plan. A few quick items from our side: 

- Jul 5 is OK for the canary start but we prefer the canary to run over a full business week if possible (Mon–Fri); our Ops team wants a Monday start so they can monitor during dayshift. Can we shift to Jul 12–16?
- On-call for migration: that's myself (Jordan Lee) and our SRE lead, Priya Menon (priya.menon@skybridge.io). Priya will be primary.
- Maintenance windows: we prefer weekdays 02:00–05:00 PT for bulk data imports, but for the canary we can accept daytime monitoring.

Also: We need a short written evaluation plan that defines KPIs for the canary (latency P95, error rate, and end-to-end job success). Can you surface the exact metrics you'll be tracking and the pass/fail criteria? Procurement looped in for DocuSign.

-Jordan
Director of Platform Engineering, SkyBridge Systems
[No attachments]

On Tue, Jun 15, 2027 at 09:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Jordan — great to be moving forward, and congrats on the closed contract...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: SkyBridge production cutover & evaluation plan

Folks — looping in a proposal for the KPI evaluation and an updated cutover cadence based on Jordan's preference for a Mon–Fri canary. Draft notes below; I've attached a migration checklist and a condensed training agenda for the CSM/engineering sessions.

Proposed KPI evaluation (canary cohorts):
- Latency: P50/P95/P99 (compare to baseline) — pass if P95 increase <= 15% and P99 <= 1.5x baseline
- Error rate: application and 5xx — pass if error rate <= 0.5% over 24h window
- Job success (batch jobs): end-to-end success >= 99%
- Business validation: sample of 200 transactions validated by SkyBridge ops (acceptance > 98%)

Canary schedule (updated):
- Jul 12 (Mon): Canary cohort A (10% traffic) — 48h monitoring
- Jul 14 (Wed): Canary cohort B (25% traffic) — 48h monitoring
- Jul 16 (Fri): Assessment & decision; if OK, begin progressive migration next week

Training plan (attached: Training_Agenda.pdf): two 90-min sessions during Week 4 (Jul 19–23) — one for Platform Ops, one for App Owners. We recommend recording and sharing slides.

Attachments: Migration_Checklist.xlsx, Training_Agenda.pdf.

I'll update the MAP PDF with these KPIs and return version 1.1 by EOD today. Steph, can you confirm we have a 48h rollback window for each cohort and the exact runbook owner?

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Migration_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]
[Attachment: Training_Agenda.pdf (PDF, 85KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@skybridge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@skybridge.io>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: SkyBridge production cutover & evaluation plan

Jordan — thanks for the fast response and for assigning Priya. We will shift the canary to Jul 12–16 per Marissa's updated schedule. Key confirmations and next steps: 

1) Canary & evaluation: Jul 12–16 (cohort A 10% -> cohort B 25%, see Marissa's notes). Pass/fail KPIs are in the MAP v1.1 (we'll attach in the follow-up).
2) Migration on-call: Priya Menon (priya.menon@skybridge.io) — we'll add her to the runbook and PagerDuty swap.
3) Maintenance windows: We'll do bulk imports in the 02:00–05:00 PT window you requested; the canary monitoring will be daytime.
4) DocuSign: Procurement — please sign the change order. Link: https://docusign.net/EXAMPLE-SB-0421

I've scheduled a 30-min kickoff for Tue, Jun 29 at 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent separately) to walk the MAP and assign owners for the migration checklist items. Marissa will deliver MAP v1.1 by EOD with the updated KPIs and a condensed cutover playbook.

If that all looks good, we'll treat this as the working schedule and track progress in the shared playbook at https://redwood.example.com/playbooks/SB-2027-0421.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_SkyBridge_v1.1.pdf (PDF, 470KB)]
